reviews.title: Best flexibility/mobility app ever
reviews.text: I am a collegiate baseball player who had a chronically tight posterior chain. I had my strength coach recommend this app for me and it has changed my life. After consistently using this app  for about a month now I am able to touch my toes for the first time in my life.

reviews.title: Excellent app for stretching
reviews.text: It’s the only stretching/mobility app that I’ve been able to keep to.  Doesn’t ask for too much or too little and you can adopted to your skill set. Good range of different types of stretches and different varieties and different options. I highly recommend as I’ve been keeping to this for over a year now.

reviews.title: Free Version is B.S
reviews.text:
Everything they do is to push you into the paid version.

Response to dev team:

Yes a free library that i can get anywhere. The only useful thing about this app was the mobility test. And that is no where near what you are charging.

reviews.title: Not Beginner Friendly
reviews.text: I’m a fairly athletic person and an avid runner, so I thought this would be a great app to help me improve my mobility.  The interface and usability is good,  but I was disappointed to find that many of the stretches/exercises are overly complicated and difficult to the point that I can’t even do them on the ‘easy mode’.  Most of these are targeting basic muscle groups that could easily be covered with a simpler movement.  There is also no way to mark specific stretches/movements as not wanted, so I’m running into the same movements that I can’t do or are painful to do in every single session.  If I was flexible enough to do these workouts I wouldn’t need the app in the first place.

reviews.title: Great app, but some inconsistencies
reviews.text: I love the app, but there are a few problems with it. My biggest concern is that some of the targeted muscle groups and Stimulus appear to be wrong or incomplete. The lunge rotation in my Daily showed different targets areas than the Library and the pec stretch on the ground doesn’t list the back list the other big muscles that are impacted like other stretches. These are minor points, but they are not accurate and inconsistent.

reviews.title: Great app but excludes many sports
reviews.text: LOVE this app- very helpful for me as someone who does gymnastics competitively. The only thing holding me back from 5 stars is that there is no option for gymnastics as a sport. It is also a weird coincidence that cheer, dance, skating etc are not included! Great app but please include ALL sports.

reviews.title: Paywall
reviews.text: This app is great but it feels like you can only use it by spending money. You can't favorite stretches without paying for a subsciption. It would be a lot better if it was less restrictive for those who don't want to pay money. Even if you want to start the 7 day free trial you need to enter your credit card info without even starting the subscription, and it automatically takes $125 right after the 7 days run out.

reviews.title: No skateboarding?
reviews.text: This is a great stretching and mobility app, but why is there no skateboarding under sports?

reviews.title: Incredible
reviews.text:
GOWOD has been a great addition to my daily routine. I used the other popular mobility app for a while before switching and this is by far the best of the two. I have no complaints! This is strictly feedback for small improvements that would be beneficial to *some. 

My first suggestion is to make an option for a widget on the phones home screen. Those are great reminders to open an app. 

Another suggestion would be to allow a selection of multiple positions for one sport. Ex: for (flag) football or basketball, some play multiple positions. I’m not sure what really changes from position to position but it would still be nice to select, just in case. 

My last suggestion is to add more of the popular Crossfit Programs to the list. I understand it’s only the list of partners, but Mayhem would be another great addition to that list. 

Thank you for hearing me out!

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: I am using this every day and have seen a significant difference

reviews.title: GOWOD Review: the only thing holding it back from being a 5 (1 major issue please read developers)
reviews.text: The app is amazing towards those with very specific goals and serious users. The user interface is extremely clean. The only issue I have with this app is the fact that it doesn’t have widgets. I use widget to see my weekly progress easily on my phone for my protocol, but I have to use a shortcut instead. I know you guys can do better. I bet it’s not hard to create one, and it would make this app even more tolerable. That’s the only thing holding back my review from being a 5. If you guys change it I will change it because the app would be more complete. We just need amazing, clean looking widgets.

reviews.title: It’s become a treasured habit
reviews.text: When my husband bought the GOWOD app, I told him “why would you buy an app to tell you how to stretch? But oh my goodness, he was right as usual. It’s been a game changer for my mobility, flexibility, and preworkout activation. I use it daily to warm up for lifting, and I use the Sleep routine before bed nightly. I HIGHLY recommend this app. I enjoy stretching for the first time ever.

reviews.title: Apple TV App?
reviews.text: I’d love it if there was a native Apple TV app like ROMWOD has.  It would make the experience perfect.

reviews.title: Stretching streamlined
reviews.text: Being told what to do is so much easier, and its timed with instructions. Following a routine never has been easier.

reviews.title: Wish there was audio
reviews.text:
When I get to the gym, I like to just start with this app I feel like I have to stop read through every instruction before I start the stretch to make sure that I’m doing it properly. 

If you’re looking for something super super super super simple then maybe this app is for you. I wouldn’t pay more than $45 a year for these. It’s just organized stretches.

reviews.title: Love it.
reviews.text: Please add a different option for the bell, maybe not one so sharp.

reviews.title: They need an editor
reviews.text:
The very first exercise they gave had written instructions that did not match the video with it. 
I have no interest in trying to figure out which thing they want me to do.  Glad there was 7 days free. I tried it for 2 minutes and found it to be useless.

reviews.title: Not much of a free version
reviews.text: The app itself is $14 a month or you can get a discounted price of $125 for a year. If you’re looking for guided routines you might as well go to YouTube and save yourself the money. Overall, very disappointed at the “free“ version of this app.

reviews.title: One Flaw
reviews.text: I like this app a lot, except for one thing: in-app sound is lost when mirroring to a TV (& Customer Support took multiple communications before they even realized this!)

reviews.title: No sounds
reviews.text: Sound doesn’t work when I do the routines and very simple exercises, I thought there would be a lot more to it

reviews.title: Great personalized mobility!
reviews.text: I’ve been getting into running and Hyrox and was looking for a mobility program that would help with both, and I think I found it! So far, so good. My only request is that, during  exercises that are two sided, it would be nice if there were some sort of chime or a bell to tell you to switch sides. Otherwise, I have to kind of squint and look at my phone and it ruins the flow. But overall I’m very happy!

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: Keeps me actually doing recovery

reviews.title: Excellent App
reviews.text: I didn’t know how it truly was going to work. The mobility test before you start provides an insight of your weak areas. I’ve used it for a month. My score has improved by 30%. I was really bad. But it’s not the numbers I’m after. I actually feel way better in the mornings. Way less stiff. Less lower back pain when I do cycling. I pair this app with Calm every night and listen to relaxing music while I my mobility program. I definitely recommend it.

reviews.title: slick, but everything behind paywall
reviews.text: Nice design, but everything is behind a paywall! You go through a ton of screens to try to set up a workout, and once you hit "go", then you get the pricing. Don't bother trying to figure out if there's anything you can try or do without a subscription because it's all behind a subscription.

reviews.title: GoWOD
reviews.text: Absolutely love this app ! I’ve been using it consistently since February and it’s made a huge difference in my overhead activation. I’m still working on it and confident I’ll get there.

reviews.title: So many issues
reviews.text: I really regret buying the annual. This app never connects for airplay, the sound is always gone so I constantly have to stay glued to my screen timer. The big update they did a month or so back made the app so much worse. Stop and Go with pliability.

reviews.title: Landscape view
reviews.text: Can you bring back the ability to watch the videos in landscape mode please?

reviews.title: AirPlay/Chrimecast
reviews.text: Good app and design is good. Needs more personalized features. When I try to Airplay or Chrome-cast the app disconnects when transitioning to next exercise. There is no audio cues when to switch from one side to another. When in Chrome-cast the demo on screen is in fast forward. Thanks.

reviews.title: Active functional fitness needs work
reviews.text: I like the idea of being able to tell the app what workouts are going to be done so you can do a good warm up but it’s lacking a bunch of movements that would normally be done in a workout and no alternative solution for entering those in making the feature useless. This isn’t limited to functional fitness either. The same can be said for weightlifting as well.

reviews.title: Updated sports option
reviews.text: Unfortunate that when you choose CrossFit it doesn’t let you input the program you’re using only the program’s sponsored are listed which makes it quite difficult to build a program directly tailored to you. Take that away please!!

reviews.title: Update a mixed bag
reviews.text:
Recent update has positives and negatives. Primary complaint is that it immediately progresses to next activity. 

Yes there is a timed gap, but for various reasons I sometimes need a longer pause. Now I need to rush to get to phone and pause. 

Otherwise not really seeing a major change/improvement in videos or activities.

reviews.title: GOWOD subscriber for years
reviews.text:
New version broke a number of things I loved about the old version… Garmin integration no longer works, can’t seem to stop autoplay, etc. 

I’ll find an alternative.

reviews.title: Air Play Doesn’t work
reviews.text: Airplay doesn’t work properly anymore. Nor does horizontal screen.  Preferred older version.

reviews.title: Everything is behind a 14-day free trial, then a paywall.
reviews.text: Title.

reviews.title: Good concept, poor app experience
reviews.text:
There are minor features missing from this app that make it cumbersome to use. Health data doesn’t sync to Apple health (option in settings is broken). When using the watch app to progress/control which movement you are on, the audio disables for some reason?  This makes pre/post wods tough to know when to move on to the next movement. There doesn’t seem to be any Bluetooth audio support either when connected to the watch. 

Honestly if you could take the programming from GOWOD and mix it with the app experience from peloton strength+, it would be the elite mobility app. For the price it should be.

reviews.title: Easy to stay consistent
reviews.text: With the options of 8-15-22 minutes allows me to get something in each day

reviews.title: Do not recommend
reviews.text: Signed up with HWPO for 1 month trial. Used it 1-2 times, was unimpressed, cancelled within the first week. 5 months later logged into App Store and see they’ve been charging me every month.

reviews.title: Love the variety of stretches, and flexibility on props
reviews.text:
I’m into my second month and finding real benefits. It doesn’t get boring, even in my focus areas, as there are so many different exercises for the same body parts.

One feature request: when you make a mistake in entering your mobility test results, the only way to fix it is to do the all the tests again. It would be great to have the ability to just redo the one test component that is wrong.

reviews.title: Worth the money
reviews.text: Really good overall. Only complaint is the new watch app for Apple Watch does not work as expected. The timer stops weirdly when watch is facing away. Tried changing always on settings but didn’t help. Hope they fix it.

reviews.title: Good pre workout, meh post workout
reviews.text: Great pre workout stretching. Post workout I can only use a gun, foam roller, and ball. Would like to be able to get a basic post workout stretch routine based off my WOD for the amount the subscription costs.

reviews.title: The best
reviews.text: After trying some other apps I can say this is the best one. It combines mobility and flexibility and the routines vary to make it more entertaining and enjoyable.

reviews.title: Sorry but junk
reviews.text: Very generic and very light routines - very ineffective. May work as PT/ rehab, possibly elderly people. Not for youngsters

reviews.title: Lift series
reviews.text: Why doesn’t the programming have a warm up.

reviews.title: Just a few days in but it’s amazing
reviews.text: It measures your current state of flexibility and gives you a daily program focusing on your weak points. It’s easy to follow and the target areas and easy mode are all great at helping you understand the desired feel from the movement.

reviews.title: Thank you!
reviews.text: Very helpful with my CrossFit journey. Has helped me tremendously with mobility overall.

reviews.title: If you subscribe you won’t be able to easily unsubscribe.
reviews.text: Don’t subscribe unless you want to have a difficult time unsubscribing and fighting charges when you haven’t had the app in over 3 years.

reviews.title: Just do it!
reviews.text: I’m 56 year’s old and over the years I’ve been losing my mobility. I’ve tried yoga and other stretching programs but I find that the GOWOD programming has been the most helpful. The mobility assessment and the personalized programming is a game changer. Just do it you won’t regret it well worth every penny!

reviews.title: Can’t recommend enough
reviews.text: I watch a good amount of CrossFit influencers on instagram and YouTube, and I always thought you had to pay for the actual app or the services within the app. The only thing you have to pay for is the premium subscription (which most influencers already have), but the app itself is totally free, gives super awesome mobility movements, and the filters for the library of movements is awesome. If you’re on the fence, get the app. You won’t regret it.

reviews.title: Some moves too complicated
reviews.text: Love how this app is set up. The major issue I have with it, is that some of the moves are so complicated (even on easy) and I don’t have the flexibility quite yet to do the move which ends up in me not feeling the stretch. This happens with 2 of the 8 moves at least every night. Other than that, the app’s convenience is really nice. Might have to find something more fitted to me though.

reviews.title: Overall a good app
reviews.text:
This is overall a great mobility app. I’ve tried a few and this is my preferred. There are aspects I really liked about pliability. It wasn’t just CrossFit focused and focused on all the other sports that I play.

However, the UI of GOWOD is so much better. The only thing I wish they could improve would be adding more common lifting exercises I don’t always do Wods or CrossFit style workouts. So having the ability to enter more bodybuilding type lifts would be awesome.

For now I have to type in a movement that most closely matches common lift that are not done in CrossFit. Like calves, dumbbell or cable, leg extensions and leg curls etc. 

Having these types of exercises in the data base would bump this up 2 stars easily.
